title: Herbed Croatian Oatmeal Bowl
description: A light peppery oatmeal bowl infused with fresh Croatian herbs and caramelized vegetables, finished with a splash of lemon. It is a quick, solo-dinner option that brings Mediterranean flavors to a comforting bowl.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion, carrot, and zucchini, sauté until softened and caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and black pepper, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in rolled oats, stirring to coat them in the oil and vegetables, toast for 2 minutes.
Add water and sea salt, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook the oatmeal, stirring occasionally, until the oats absorb the liquid and reach a creamy consistency, about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in chopped dill, parsley, and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if needed.
Divide the oatmeal into bowls and sprinkle crumbled feta cheese on top, if desired.
Serve immediately while hot, garnished with extra herbs if desired.
